biothings.name: Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome
biothings.definition: Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome (BWS) is a genetic disorder characterized by overgrowth, tumor predisposition and congenital malformations. [Orphanet:116]
biothings.synonyms: Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome, BWS, exomphalos-macroglossia-gigantism syndrome, Wiedemann-Beckwith syndrome

biothings.name: Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome due to CDKN1C mutation
